name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-lava-lotus
title: Redrawn Styled Lava Lotus
description:
A redrawn styled version of this sprite and this sprite , It's meant to ressemble their artwork in Super Mario Bros 3.
Sonikku's sprite comes with two options, one with a green stalk and one with a turquoise stalk.
Unfortunately, Davros sprite has a small problem with how the tiles are assembled that I can't fix myself (specificaly the middle tiles), the graphics are still definely usable though.
